data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Ludovicus, Lodovico means 'famous warrior'. It is a name with a rich history, rooted in the Christian faith and the Roman Empire. The name Lodovico carries the meaning “Famous warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lodovico usually hope their child will grow to embody famous warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a name that embodies the qualities of a true Christian warrior.
